text: EasyPost is a US shipping-software company founded in 2012 by Jarrett Streebin, who leads it as CEO, according to the company's own about page.
short: EasyPost was founded by Jarrett Streebin, who is its CEO.

source.name: EasyPost: About Us
source.quote: Jarrett founded EasyPost to help online retailers achieve Amazon-level shipping capabilities with the first RESTful API for shipping.
source.note: Same page: 'It all started with a simple idea back in 2012 ... That's when EasyPost came to life' and the Leadership section lists Jarrett Streebin as CEO.
